basis: linear tetrahedral virtual nodes; exact clipped volume and first moment; positive row-sum mass, no mass scaling or removal
scope: mechanics/cut-transfer/independence/speed pilot, geometry fixtures not physical fracture
stop: first substantive failed decision gate or two hours; no new physical tomato or robot rollout until gates support it
dt_policy_addendum: Before dynamic controls: halve 25us until dt <= 0.4 of measured small-state linear stability bound; compare against half dt. Cap accepted candidate at 0.1953125us in this bounded pilot; unresolved smaller slivers remain out of qualification. No chosen dt is based on desired throughput.
force_comparison: RMS nodal internal force over shared samples, 5% relative or 1e-5 N absolute floor; energy residual <5%; point velocity difference <=5mm/s; no meaningful external impulse/work qualification without contact.
